create_jwt_token: create a JWT token using a GitHub App private key with RS256 algorithm
fetch_access_token: fetch and cache a GitHub API access token with retry logic on failure
call_github_api: make an authenticated HTTP request to the GitHub API with bearer token
get_latest_commit: get the latest commit from a GitHub pull request via the API
check_on_pr: create or update a check run on a GitHub pull request with a summary
